title: Global genetic interaction network of a human cell maps conserved principles and informs functional interpretation of gene co-essentiality profiles.
paper_method: qGI score (differential LFC vs WT reference screens, M-A loess normalization, moderated t-test), per screen; MCMC consensus across replicate screens
model: HAP1, PTAR1 query (14-bp deletion x2, 1-bp insertion) vs parental WT, TKOv3 genome-wide KO library, minimal medium (DMEM 10 mM glucose)
contrast: PTAR1 vs WT genetic interaction in minimal medium: endpoint vs T0 dropout difference, 3 PTAR1 screens vs 16 WT screens (one T0 and summed endpoints per screen)
paper_calls: 413 negative and 405 positive PTAR1 interactions (|qGI| > 0.3, FDR < 0.1) in either minimal-medium screen GIN043/GIN109
barcs_calls: 1035 genes at FDR 0.10 (518 depleted, 517 enriched); 759 against the control null
named_hits: 7/8 at FDR 0.10 (VAMP3, RAB1A, SEC23IP, GOSR1, TRAPPC12, ABHD16A, ABHD17B; not YKT6)
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's PTAR1 vesicle-trafficking negative interactions and the ABHD16A/ABHD17B suppressors (rank correlation 0.58 with the minimal-medium qGI) but not YKT6, and adds strong positive calls in p53-apoptosis and variable-fitness genes (BAX, PMAIP1, BBC3, NF2, TADA1) that the paper's network excludes.
